subject: Transportation Systems
title: Space Elevators
description: A short lesson to help you apply Space Elevators.

hook.text: A cable from Earth's surface to orbit could carry cargo to space without rockets. The concept is a space elevator.

buildup.text: A counterweight in geostationary orbit holds the cable taut. Climbers ascend electrically.

discovery.text: A space elevator could reduce the cost of reaching orbit from thousands of dollars per kilogram to tens.

twist.text: No material strong enough to build the cable exists yet. Carbon nanotubes might work—but can't be manufactured at scale.

climax.text: If anyone invents a strong enough material, space elevators could transform human presence in orbit.

punchline.text: The elevator to space waits on a material we haven't invented.

quiz.question: What is the main obstacle to building a space elevator?
options: No material strong enough for the cable exists at scale
